meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's start with why my son found out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class.
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.
A machine's guess. Even the company that sells it says it shouldn't be the only basis for punishing a student, and your own procedure says the same. So what else do you have, Hale, or is that it?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.
My child never lies. You just said "your son cheated" with nothing in your hand but a score, and I'm writing that down. Withdraw the zero, Hale, or I'm going upstairs.
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

You're threatening my son's "permanent record" because I'm questioning a zero, and I'm writing that down. Your own procedure, 4.5, puts a record note on repeated concerns, and this is a first one that nobody spoke to him about. The principal gets this today, Hale, unless you have a document.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and written confirmation that nothing goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: still at her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on Owen's record, with the principal next.
What moved her: nothing, because you showed no document, dated or otherwise, that she could check herself.
What cost ground: leading with the detector score, saying her son cheated with nothing to back it up, and then threatening his permanent record when she pushed back.
Try next time: right after her first question, say in one sentence that the zero went in before you called her, then show a dated document about Owen's own process if you have one.
